Composition rights
Underlying composition is out of copyright where the ordinary life-plus-70 term applies. Inferred, not documented

Rachmaninoff died in 1943. This is a territorial term calculation, not worldwide clearance or a statement about an unidentified modern performing edition.

[6] [7]
Recording rights
Commons records a public-domain release by Karine Gilanyan, represented by Musopen, together with an attribution-only notice. Documented

The PD-author statement is explicitly attached to the performer’s recording, not solely to Rachmaninoff’s composition. The accompanying attribution notice is honoured in the credit line. The upstream Musopen URL returned HTTP 403 during this audit, so its current page was not independently read; the source and release are reported from the explicit Commons description, not an inferred licence from the upload date.

[1]

Karine Gilanyan, piano — Rachmaninoff, Étude-tableau in E♭ minor, Op. 39 No. 5. Recording provided by Musopen; source Wikimedia Commons, which records the performer’s public-domain release and requires attribution. Rights statement
